# FireHorse

> FireHorse (https://firehorse.info) is a free site about the Fire Horse (丙午, bing wu) in the Chinese zodiac and the 2026 Year of the Fire Horse, which runs from the Lunar New Year on 17 February 2026 to 5 February 2027. The Fire Horse sign comes round once every 60 years; the previous Fire Horse year was 1966. The site has an encyclopedia, a compatibility checker and a blog. Made by Dizid (https://dizid.com); sister site of Wu Xing Zodiac (https://wuxingzodiac.me).

## Encyclopedia
- [Origin of the Fire Horse](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/origin-of-the-fire-horse)
- [Fire Horse personality traits](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/fire-horse-personality-traits)
- [The 1966 Hinoeuma phenomenon](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/the-1966-hinoeuma-phenomenon): Japan's sharp drop in births in 1966, when many families avoided having a Fire Horse daughter.
- [The Fire Horse in Chinese culture](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/fire-horse-chinese-culture)
- [The Fire Horse in Japanese culture](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/fire-horse-japanese-culture)
- [Famous Fire Horses](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/famous-fire-horses)
- [Fire Horse myths and superstitions](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/fire-horse-myths-superstitions)
- [2026: the next Fire Horse generation](https://firehorse.info/encyclopedia/2026-next-fire-horse-generation)

## Tools
- [Compatibility checker](https://firehorse.info/compatibility): pick your animal sign and element to see your compatibility score with the Fire Horse and what it means for a relationship. Free.

## Blog
- [All articles](https://firehorse.info/blog), for example [the 2026 Year of the Fire Horse](https://firehorse.info/blog/2026-year-of-fire-horse), [Japan's Fire Horse superstition and birth rate](https://firehorse.info/blog/japan-fire-horse-superstition-birth-rate) and [a guide to the Chinese zodiac elements](https://firehorse.info/blog/chinese-zodiac-elements-guide).
- [Hinoeuma 2026: Japan's births rose, not fell](https://firehorse.info/blog/hinoeuma-2026-japan-births): Japan's official January-June 2026 birth counts (up 0.8%, or 0.4% for Japanese nationals) compared with 1906 and 1966, with sources.
- [Born in 1966? You turn 60 in your own Fire Horse year](https://firehorse.info/blog/born-1966-turn-60-fire-horse-year): the 60-year cycle, Japan's kanreki, Korea's hwangap and Chinese 60th-birthday foods; who counts as a 1966 Fire Horse (21 January 1966 to 8 February 1967).
- [Yaoya Oshichi: the 1683 story behind the Fire Horse curse](https://firehorse.info/blog/yaoya-oshichi-fire-horse-curse-origin): the Edo arson case that tied Fire Horse women to fire, what is known about her uncertain 1666 birth year, and how the belief reached 1906 and 1966.
